title: applyLayout
description: Backend RPC action: applies pixel-space width, height, stroke weight, and corner radii from the UI to every node in the current selection.

params.name: msg
params.description: Layout payload already converted to pixels by the UI.

width.description: Target width in px, or 'mixed' to leave unchanged.

height.description: Target height in px, or 'mixed' to leave unchanged.

radius.description: Uniform corner radius in px when isMainRadiusChanged is true.

radiusIndividual.description: Per-corner radii { tl, tr, br, bl }; each may be number, 'mixed', or null.

strokeWeight.description: Stroke weight in px, or 'mixed'/null to skip.

isMainRadiusChanged.description: True when the uniform radius field was edited; false when individual corners were edited.

returns.description: { ok: true } on success, or { ok: false, error } when there is no selection.
